text: {"type_map":{},"constraints":[{"id":"R1","category":"protocol","alternatives":["((df['PROTOCOL'] == 6) | ((df['TCP_FLAGS'] == 0) & (df['CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS'] == 0) & (df['SERVER_TCP_FLAGS'] == 0)))"],"features":["PROTOCOL","TCP_FLAGS","CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS","SERVER_TCP_FLAGS"],"rationale":"For a non-TCP IP protocol there are no TCP flags to contribute to any of the cumulative TCP flag fields."},{"id":"R2","category":"protocol","alternatives":["((df['PROTOCOL'] == 6) | ((df['RETRANSMITTED_IN_BYTES'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_OUT_BYTES'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS'] == 0)))"],"features":["PROTOCOL","RETRANSMITTED_IN_BYTES","RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS","RETRANSMITTED_OUT_BYTES","RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS"],"rationale":"The retransmission features count retransmitted TCP traffic, so they must be zero when the IP protocol is not TCP."},{"id":"R3","category":"protocol","alternatives":["((df['PROTOCOL'] == 1) | (df['ICMP_IPV4_TYPE'] == 0))"],"features":["PROTOCOL","ICMP_IPV4_TYPE"],"rationale":"ICMP_IPV4_TYPE describes an IPv4 ICMP message type and therefore cannot be populated for a non-ICMPv4 IP protocol."},{"id":"R4","category":"protocol","alternatives":["((df['PROTOCOL'] != 1) | ((df['ICMP_TYPE'] // 256) == df['ICMP_IPV4_TYPE']))"],"features":["PROTOCOL","ICMP_TYPE","ICMP_IPV4_TYPE"],"rationale":"For ICMPv4, ICMP_TYPE encodes the ICMP type in the high-order part as type times 256 plus code, so its quotient by 256 must equal the IPv4 type."}]}
